_source: Remaster data for a Phantasie I import from the Apple II copy alone (profile p1-apple2), applied by the importer (OpenPhantasie.Importer.Pipelines.P1Apple2.P1Apple2Tables). Made by tools/scripts/diff_a2_p1_vs_dos.py --built from the importer's raw Apple build and DOS I's data.
_note: Between versions DOS wins on numbers (AGENTS.md): an Apple-only import takes the Apple's text and names, and DOS I's value in every cell where the Apple's number differs (reverse-engineering/apple2/phantasie1/FORMAT.md section 5).
_dos_cells: CellPatches, as c64-import.json's: a path into the GameData file the Apple import builds (DOS shape); byte = an offset into a hex string; fog = a map tile whose fog (tile + 120) is kept. A cell holding the Apple value takes the DOS value; one holding neither is kept and warned.
_name_fixes: As dos_cells, but the Apple's name and the fixed one (CHAR's 12-byte field reads FIRE ELE, as the C64's; D-087).

name_fixes.why: the fire elemental's name, M cut off (CHAR record 37; as D-083 / D-087)
the same name in the town labels
monster 12's typo (MN1 record 4; D-089, user s223)
the same name in the name table
monster 58's typo (MN7 record 2; D-089, user s223)
the same name in the name table

_sprite_sizes: DOS's monster sprite (width, height) per monster (PHANTASI.COM DS:0x2c3e): the encounter build's group fit reads the width. The Apple has no such table (it draws shapes at a SCALE).
_scroll_compass: The Apple draws the wilderness turned a quarter (its north = DOS's east) and its region texts and scrolls follow its own compass. Each word on the left, at the start of a word (SOUTH-, a compound before its first half), becomes the one on the right, all at once; a scroll box's closing ! keeps its column (as II's Apple import, DIFFERENCES-II D2-046).
_spell_names: The Apple has no spell names (spells are cast by number, FORMAT.md 3.3). Slots 0-53: the manual's spell table as it prints the names; slot 57 (the divine spell): not in the manual, the remaster's wording [~] (as the C64's, D-087).
